clips.title: The story
paras: South of the Great Lakeshire Bridge, Deputy Feldon watches the road into Lakeshire. Gnoll packs are creeping toward the town, and he keeps a nervous vigil.

Deputy Feldon stands watch south of the Lakeshire bridge, guarding a road needed for trade and travel. Blackrock orcs press from the north while gnoll packs overrun the southern hills, stretching the town guard thin. Feldon cannot leave his post without weakening Lakeshire's perimeter. He depends on passing adventurers to drive back the gnolls before they cut the town off.
